programme.desc: Great white male and female sharks battle each other in a series of contests to prove which is the superior sex.

programme.title: Shark Week's Alien Sharks
programme.desc: Shark experts search out the strangest sharks in the world, including the sawshark in the Bass Strait and the goblin shark in Tokyo; expeditionary teams explore the depths for sharks that glow in the dark.

programme.title: 6000 LB Shark
programme.desc: With reports of enormous fat white sharks appearing off the coast of New Zealand, scientists Tom Hird and Leigh de Necker set out to find one of these behemoths and determine if the great white can reach a staggering 6,000 lbs.

programme.title: America's Cutest - Dogs: Cutified
programme.desc: S2E4 - Exploring the canine kingdom; cute dogs; latest videos of guilty pooches; mutts with unusual pals.

programme.title: America's Cutest - Dogs: Snug-A-Licious
programme.desc: S2E5 - The cutest dogs on the web; dogs acting like nannies to human babies; athletic dogs & chatty mutts.

programme.title: The Aquarium - Slimy Is the New Fuzzy
programme.desc: S1E1 - The Georgia Aquarium sends a team to Cape Town, South Africa, to help rehabilitate and release a group of African penguins into the wild; a dive team installs a shipwreck feature into an exhibit to provide enrichment for their sea turtle.

programme.title: The Aquarium - Seal the Deal
programme.desc: S1E2 - Two African penguins, Freya and Neo, welcome a young chick, but there's cause for concern when health problems arise; staff work to train a trio of harbor seals to ride the elevator, with the only hiccup being a nervous seal named Floyd.

programme.title: The Aquarium - Otter Tale
programme.desc: S1E4 - Beloved Asian small-clawed otter Pinkie has a recurring bloody nose, the team goes to great lengths to find out what could be causing it; feisty baby American alligators arrive at the aquarium and must learn to eat in an orderly way.

programme.title: Tanked - Sherri Shepherd On the Rocks
programme.desc: S9E8 - Wayde and Brett are asked to build a simple, elegant tank for TV host and actress Sherri Shepherd; the Rugged Ridge company has tasked the crew with their most outrageous build ever.

programme.title: Tanked - Penn and Teller Monkey Magic
programme.desc: S9E7 - World-famous magicians Penn and Teller want a double-sided tank to put in their quirky backstage Monkey Room to honor their 40th anniversary together.

programme.title: Tanked - Gabriel Iglesias' Fluffy Tank
programme.desc: S9E3 - Wayde and Brett build a pair of vintage bus-inspired tanks for stand-up comedian Gabriel 'Fluffy' Iglesias' newly remodeled office.

programme.title: Tanked - Jeff Dunham's Tank for Dummies
programme.desc: S9E5 - Ventriloquist Jeff Dunham wants ATM to build a theater-themed tank with a submerged working chandelier, starring his characters Peanut, Walter and Achmed.

programme.title: Dawn of the Monster Mako
programme.desc: A 14-foot giant mako shark is spotted in the waters of Portugal's Azores region; underwater cinematographer Joe Romeiro and his wife, marine biologist Lauren, search the teeming depths around the ancient islands to capture the beast on film.

programme.title: Great White Serial Killer: Sea of Blood
programme.desc: After fatal shark attacks in 2022 and 2023 off the shore of a Mexican fishing village, shark attack survivor Paul De Gelder joins shark investigator Brandon McMillan to ID the killers and help prevent future attacks from happening.

programme.title: Great White Assassins
programme.desc: Alison Towner and Dickie Chivell investigate how killer whales hunt great whites; Dickie disguises as an orca in New Zealand.

programme.title: How to Survive a Shark Attack
programme.desc: Shark attack survivor Paul de Gelder attempts to get attacked by a shark again; under the supervision of experts, Paul provokes sharks to attack him in multiple scenarios, where they bite and tear off prosthetic limbs to teach life-saving tactics.

programme.title: In the Eye of the Storm - Shark Storm
programme.desc: In the summer of 2024, dozens of cameras captured a rare outbreak of shark attacks along America's Gulf Coast; told exclusively through first-hand accounts of victims and eyewitnesses, all these perspectives are seen unfolding in real time.

programme.title: What Shark Attacked? (New)
programme.desc: In the chaos and carnage of shark attacks caught on camera, the shark often remains unidentified; now, experts dive into real footage, analyzing behavior and bite evidence through experiments and forensics to answer the question: What shark attacked?

programme.title: Chum Island: Catching a Killer (New)
programme.desc: Floating on a raft of chum, Dr. Riley Elliott comes eye-to-eye with big great whites while on a mission to lure and tag the culprit of a shark attack spree that wrecked a tight-knit community in Australia.

programme.title: Secrets of the Great White Kill (New)
programme.desc: Dr. Riley Elliott and Kori Burkhardt cross technical frontiers and push the boundaries of personal safety to record never-before-seen predations of great white sharks on their three most formidable prey. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: Attack of the Devil Shark
programme.desc: A rogue tiger shark kills two people in the Caribbean, sparking fear that it's the legendary devil shark. A team tracks the shark behind the attacks and uncovers a seismic force driving sharks to aggression in these waters. (Special, Documentary, Nature)

programme.title: What Shark Attacked?
programme.desc: In the chaos and carnage of shark attacks caught on camera, the shark often remains unidentified; now, experts dive into real footage, analyzing behavior and bite evidence through experiments and forensics to answer the question: What shark attacked? (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: Chum Island: Catching a Killer
programme.desc: Floating on a raft of chum, Dr. Riley Elliott comes eye-to-eye with massive great whites while on a mission to lure and tag the culprit of a brutal shark attack spree that wrecked a tight-knit community in Australia. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: Secrets of the Great White Kill
programme.desc: Dr. Riley Elliott and Kori Burkhardt cross technical frontiers and push the boundaries of personal safety to record never-before-seen predations of great white sharks on their three most formidable prey. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: Attack of the Devil Shark
programme.desc: A rogue tiger shark kills two people in the Caribbean, sparking fear that it's the legendary devil shark. A team tracks the shark behind the attacks and uncovers a seismic force driving sharks to aggression in these waters. (Special, Documentary, Nature)

programme.title: Great White Serial Killer: Sea of Blood
programme.desc: After fatal shark attacks in 2022 and 2023 off the shore of a Mexican fishing village, shark attack survivor Paul De Gelder joins shark investigator Brandon McMillan to ID the killers and help prevent future attacks from happening. (Special, Animals, Documentary, Nature)

programme.title: Great White Assassins
programme.desc: Alison Towner and Dickie Chivell investigate how killer whales hunt great whites; Dickie disguises as an orca in New Zealand. (Special, Documentary, Nature)

programme.title: Gator Boys - Alligator Rampage
programme.desc: S1E1 - Paul and Jimmy argue over Jimmy's goal to expand the Gator Boys Rescue Operation; Jimmy disappears; Paul tries to keep the Gator Boys from falling apart. (Reality, Animals)

programme.title: Gator Boys - Mama Gator Mayhem
programme.desc: S1E3 - Paul and Jimmy capture a monster-sized gator; an alligator fights to protect her young. (Reality, Animals)

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation - Elephant in the Room (New)
programme.desc: S4E6 - Elephant populations in many protected African reserves are expanding, but what happens to them when a reserve reaches its capacity? Visiting Zimbabwe, Namibia, and Angola, Dan Cabela investigates a growing problem for the future of elephant conservation. (Docudrama, Science, Nature, Animals)

programme.title: Nature's Strangest Mysteries: Solved - Disco Spider
programme.desc: S1E14 - A look at why some spiders disco dance; a mysterious creature is preying on Europe's sheep; a whole town is engulfed by bubbling foam. (Documentary, Nature)

programme.title: Jurassic Sharks
programme.desc: Prehistoric sharks rise from the dead as biologists investigate early predators that ruled the seas; global expeditions yield new evidence of sharks that once roamed the ocean, and CGI technology brings them back to life. (Special, Documentary, Science, Nature)

programme.title: Jaws vs. Orca
programme.desc: Great white sharks are under siege by orcas; experts push into dangerous waters off the coast of Spain, provoking attacks on their boats to reveal how killer whales dominate their rival. (Special, Documentary, Science, Nature)

programme.title: House of Sharks
programme.desc: In New Zealand's waters, great white "houses" battle for dominance; experts risk it all to reveal the bloodlines that determine their allegiances. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: Invasion of the Mega Sharks
programme.desc: Off Nova Scotia's coast is rumored to be the elusive Big Rose, a female great white believed to be one of the largest predators in the North Atlantic. Using innovative tagging technology and daring field ops, a team attempts to find this ocean giant. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: Bull Shark Dinner Bell
programme.desc: Shark attack survivor Paul de Gelder and predator specialist Rosie Moore head to Jupiter, Florida to uncover what's fueling a surge in bull shark aggression. Testing weather, prey and human behavior, they build toward one explosive final demonstration. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: Air Jaws: Red, White and Breach
programme.desc: Reports and video evidence of flying great whites off the California coast sparks a mission to capture the new phenomena on film and determine if Air Jaws has taken flight in America. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: Air Jaws: Final Frontier
programme.desc: Shark filmmakers hunt for "Air Jaws" in New Zealand's hidden launch pad; Andy Casagrande and Jeff Kurr seek the second breaching great white to uncover secrets from these waters. (Special, Animals, Event)

programme.title: Air Jaws: The Hunted (New)
programme.desc: In 2017, five full-grown great white sharks wash up dead on beaches in South Africa; biologist Alison Towner searches for orcas, the possible culprits in this grisly crime, in an effort to find out how great white sharks are being wiped out. (Special, Documentary, Nature, Animals)

programme.title: Great White Fight Club
programme.desc: A team of experts ventures into the treacherous waters of New Zealand to provide groundbreaking evidence that female white sharks unequivocally dominate the ocean, reigning as the ultimate controllers of its fierce battlegrounds. (Special, Documentary, Animals, Nature)

programme.title: Great White North Invasion
programme.desc: Great whites flood the quiet shores of Nova Scotia, threatening locals and igniting a mission to track the biggest sharks to identify the most dangerous areas before a deadly encounter. (Special, Documentary, Nature)

programme.title: Caught! Sharks Strike Back
programme.desc: Shark encounters are being captured on camera, showcasing everything from funny interactions to moments of pursuit; focusing on some crazy moments when sharks strike back. (Special, Documentary, Nature, Animals)

programme.title: Ultimate Shark Dive (New)
programme.desc: For the first time ever, cliff diver Molly Carlson attempts what no other human has dared to do: dive off a helicopter into a cage surrounded by sharks; to survive this stunt, she must train alongside shark experts and prepare for the worst. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: Biggest Mako on Earth (New)
programme.desc: A new report of a 15-foot mako shark off the coast of Mexico shatters conventional wisdom on how large these sharks can grow; a team of experts heads to the Pacific Ocean to track down this mega shark and find the biggest mako in the world. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: Sharkzilla Takes New York (New)
programme.desc: After a slew of mauled marine life washes ashore in NY, Dr. Craig O'Connell starts a search to find the culprit; when it leads him to an old nuclear dumping ground ringed with great whites and makos, he theorizes that the predator may be radioactive. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Morena and the Marcona
programme.desc: S29E13 - Bobby Flay tries to make chefs Raymond Yaptinchay and Cara Stadler go nuts in the kitchen. Michael Voltaggio and actress Morena Baccarin are there to cheer them on to victory. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: BBQ Brawl - Impress Us
programme.desc: S3E8 - The three finalists have one more chance to prove themselves worthy of the title of Master of 'Cue; in the last challenge, the competitors go all out to impress the judges -- and deal with some curveballs along the way. (Competition reality, Cooking, Reality)

programme.title: Chopped - Double-Edged Swordfish
programme.desc: S57E11 - The chefs create a kitchen traffic jam when the first basket inspires them to all use the deep fryer; the competitors struggle to make juicy swordfish steaks, and an unusual cheese product for dessert prompts one chef to attempt a cheesecake. (Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Chopped - Death is Not an Option
programme.desc: S59E15 - Four brave chefs prioritize flavor over fear as they take on outrageously daring ingredients to make killer dishes for the judges; the chefs prove they have the chops to make a swamp-loving chomper tasty and try not to be stung by a shocking sweet. (Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Chopped - Carnivore Converter
programme.desc: S62E7 - Competitors race to turn mystery ingredients into three-course meals; the competition is all about skill, speed and ingenuity. (Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Chopped - Fluke Rebuke
programme.desc: S64E1 - The chefs find a peculiar cereal and fluke fillets in the first basket; the entrée round ingredients run the gamut from light to hearty and the finalists must work a clever crêpe and an interactive candy into their desserts. (Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Bobby's Triple Threat - Titans vs. Eric Adjepong
programme.desc: S3E4 - Chef Eric Adjepong has a smile on his face as he takes on his friends, Bobby Flay's Titans; with $25,000 and bragging rights on the line, Eric must manage the clock and the pressure from his pals. (Competition reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Bobby's Triple Threat - Titans vs. Silvia Barban
programme.desc: S3E5 - Chef Silvia Barban has one thing on her mind, and that's sweet revenge; Brooke Williamson has beaten Silvia in the past, and it's still on her mind! If she can handle the hurdles of Bobby Flay's Triple Threat kitchen, she just may taste it. (Competition reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Bobby's Triple Threat - Titans vs. Shirley Chung
programme.desc: S3E2 - Chef Shirley Chung has a bone to pick with Bobby Flay's Titans, especially her former roommate, Brooke Williamson; while Shirley's intimate knowledge could lead to their downfall, Iron Chef Geoffrey Zakarian's judging keeps everyone on their toes. (Competition reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Hale to the Chefs
programme.desc: S30E14 - Comedic actor Tony Hale seeks Amanda Freitag's help; they bring in chefs Cristian Rebolledo and Matt Migliore to create a globally inspired dish. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Talk the Shiitake
programme.desc: S31E6 - Chefs Saif Rahman and Carolina Gomez must walk the walk and talk the shiitake to go up against Bobby Flay while Esther Choi and Michael Symon cheer them on. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Kitchen Update
programme.desc: S31E7 - "Saturday Night Live's" Colin Jost teams up with Carla Hall and enlists the help of chefs Jo Proul and Katsui Tanabe to make Bobby Flay the butt of the joke. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Bouillabaisse-ic Instinct
programme.desc: S32E10 - Chefs Dan Jackson and Camila Rinaldi are aided and abetted by Sunny Anderson and Jet Tila as they try to slay Bobby Flay. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Shock, Awe and Shakshuka
programme.desc: S33E12 - Chef Michael Voltaggio and actress Ellie Kemper bring the pain as chefs Travis McGinty and Suzanne Vizethann crack more than a few eggs in their quest to take down Bobby Flay. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Tame the Lion's Mane
programme.desc: S35E8 - Michael Voltaggio and Christian Petroni choose chefs Lanny Chin and Wendy Zeng to tackle a tricky star ingredient in hopes of defeating Bobby Flay. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - From Plies to Plating
programme.desc: S37E2 - Andrew Zimmern and Misty Copeland dance circles around Bobby Flay as chefs Tristen Epps and Vinnie Cimino make sure their plates are on point. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - BFFs vs. Bobby
programme.desc: S37E13 - BFFs Carla Hall and Tiffany Derry are pumped up and rarin' to go as chefs Pam Liberda and Chris Sanchez attempt to Thai one on with Bobby Flay. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - The Thrill of the Grill
programme.desc: S40E3 - Josh Capon and Today's Dylan Dreyer fire up Bobby Flay's grill with pitmasters Matt Abdoo and Dominique Leach. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Mole Mania
programme.desc: S41E19 - Actor Jeff Hiller and Amanda Freitag band together with chefs Thomas Bille and Keegan Andrews to cook up a spicy dose of defeat for Bobby Flay. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call - Caviar Dreams (New)

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Secret Service - Marvel Ranch (New)
programme.desc: S1E5 - Gordon must tame a brawling staff and transform a sloppy kitchen crew into proper chefs.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Secret Service - Wilson's Secret Sauce (New)
programme.desc: S1E6 - Gordon must help the owner of Wilson's Secret Sauce, by minimizing the menu and inventory, and focusing on barbecue staples.

programme.title: Kitchen Nightmares - In the Drink
programme.desc: S1E3 - Ramsay attempts to revamp a country club restaurant that struggles to find cohesiveness and revive its lackluster menu, despite an absent owner.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Flirting With Victory
programme.desc: S27E4 - Chef Alex Guarnaschelli gets an assist from actress Malin Akerman, who proves to be more of a distraction than Bobby Flay can handle; chefs Andrew Bent and Alejandro Barrientos try to steal a win; Malin runs interference in Bobby's kitchen.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay - The Battle for Saratoga
programme.desc: S27E5 - Golf phenom Michelle Wie joins Food Network's Scott Conant to add a stroke to Bobby Flay's game; Saratoga, N.Y., chefs Jeannette Liebers and Chris Bonnivier are on the scene to make sure Bobby takes a mulligan.

programme.title: Tournament of Champions - Time for Battle
programme.desc: S5E1 - Guy Fieri kicks off year five; from big names in past seasons to new chefs with the potential to go all the way, they'll all face off to win the belt, the coveted title and $150,000.

programme.title: The Great Food Truck Race - Sweet & Savory: The Tennessee Whiskey Trail
programme.desc: S19E2 - Tyler Florence leads seven teams to Franklin to compete along the Tennessee Whiskey Trail; after razor-thin sales margins and a whiskey-focused redemption battle, guest judge Aarti Sequeira sends one of the two bottom trucks home.

programme.title: Pitmasters - Rooter to Tooter & Head-to-Head
programme.desc: S1E4 - The six remaining teams face off in a nose-to-tail barbecue battle, transforming either a hog, goat, or lamb into two main dishes and two sides; with $2,000 on the line, they must use the remaining parts of their animal to make sausage.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games - City Food Fight: Los Angeles vs. San Francisco
programme.desc: S38E5 - Guy Fieri invites culinary duos from Los Angeles and San Francisco to each prepare three-course feasts designed to prove which city's food is best; they use ingredients from both cities in hopes of winning $15,000 and Golden State bragging rights.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games - City Food Fight: Chicago vs. NYC
programme.desc: S38E6 - Guy brings in chef duos from Chicago and New York to prepare a feast that proves their city's food is world-class; they use ingredients that celebrate The Big Apple and Chicago's The Bean in hopes of scoring $15,000 and big city bragging rights.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games - Ultimate City Food Fight
programme.desc: S38E7 - The winners of the first two City Food Fights face off to prove their city's culinary supremacy; Guy Fieri sets up games inspired by their city's basketball teams; the winning team takes home $15,000 and the GGG City Food Fight champion trophy!

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Tacos, Turtles and Tri-Tip
programme.desc: S24E6 - Sampling pork belly tacos and carne adobada in a high-energy marketplace in Oakland; turtle soup in Islamorada, Florida; savory crepes and a saucy twist on traditional beignets in Stockton, California.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Succulent Sandwiches
programme.desc: S24E7 - In Oakland, killer cheesesteak and off-the-chain chicken; in Modesto, Calif., pastrami on pretzel bread and root beer pulled pork; in Key Largo, Fla., a seafood staple servin' up a sandwich that's become a local legend.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Asia, Africa and India
programme.desc: S25E2 - In Los Angeles, house-made hot dogs and pork adobo piled onto grilled cheese; in San Francisco, chicken jambalaya; in Minneapolis, tikka masala and naan.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Burgers, Buns and Bagels
programme.desc: S25E8 - Guy visits an amped-up deli serving up lamb burgers and ribs; a Koreatown favorite loads up Asian buns and a unique bacon-corn bar dish; a world-class bagel shop spices up their specialty and tops things off with Jersey's famous pork roll.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Belly Up to Barcelona
programme.desc: S26E1 - Guy Fieri heads to Barcelona, Spain; a homey spot serving Galician-style octopus and soup; a grab-and-go sandwich place serving sausage and sauces; a family-owned place serving traditional dishes like rabbit and snail.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Ocean Coasts and Great Lakes
programme.desc: S27E6 - In Los Angeles, a Mexican joint in Grand Central Market serves outrageous octopus tostadas and their spin on a burger; in Norfolk, a bistro turns out grown-up, gourmet grilled cheese; a righteous stop in Lansing does it up right.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Pizza, Pork and Peru
programme.desc: S28E11 - In Lansing, Mich., an out-of-this-world pizza joint features pie with a surprise; in Wilmington, N.C., standout sandwiches bring a taste of Philly to the South; a unique spot in Tucson, Ariz., cooks up real-deal Peruvian specialties.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Pretzels, Pork and Paella
programme.desc: S29E5 - Guy digs into everything from pretzels to paella; in Bozeman, Mont., a five-star take on breakfast with a Mexican pork masterpiece; in Little Rock, Ark., a microbrewery serves elevated pub grub; a Mediterranean-inspired restaurant serving up paella.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Beef Bonanza
programme.desc: S32E10 - In Wilmington, Del., there's a 1940s Italian family spot that's making beef braciole and meaty ravioli from scratch; a diner putting elevated spins on the French dip and meatloaf in San Diego; a Middle Eastern joint in El Paso, Texas.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - From Beef to Bao
programme.desc: S35E5 - Guy's digging into dishes from beef to buns and in Logan, Utah, a place is serving up worldwide flavor, like lomo saltado and a peanut butter burger.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Spicin' Things Up
programme.desc: S38E2 - Guy Fieri's grabbing sandwiches, spice and everything nice, starting with lights-out lamb in Fargo, N.D.; a spot in Sioux Falls, S.D., is loading up hand-held flavor bombs and in Fairbanks, Alaska, a wild pizza place is making spicy, sweet pies.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Meaty, Cheesy and Sweet
programme.desc: S42E4 - Waffles in Anchorage, Alaska, and steak tacos in Aspen, Colo.; in Albuquerque, N.M., a Latin place makes arepas and pork paninis.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Specialty Spots
programme.desc: S52E2 - An uncle-nephew duo is changing the game in Gainesville, Fla., with a fried chicken sandwich; there's Mexican gone vegan in Dallas, Texas; a spot in Baton Rouge, LA, is putting their stamp on pot pie.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Soup, Salad and Sorbet Spins
programme.desc: S53E7 - Guy Fieri is sampling fresh takes on traditional dishes, starting with carnitas ramen in Austin, Texas; a funky joint in Cincinnati, Ohio, is plating pulled pork poutine.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Beef, Chicken, and Pork (New)
programme.desc: S55E10 - Guy Fieri's digging into beef, chicken and more! A Tampa butcher is bringing righteous roast pork from farm to sandwich, a pastaria in Bentonville, AR, is plating lights-out lasagna.

programme.title: The Hangover Part III
programme.desc: Phil, Stu and Doug take Alan on a road trip to help him through a personal crisis. Mr. Chow breaks out of prison and prepares to wreak havoc.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: Seasoned warrior Sarah Connor joins forces with a hybrid cyborg human and the T-800 model to protect a young woman from the Rev-9 -- a newly modified and seemingly indestructible liquid Terminator from the future.

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: A publicity-seeking Chicago lawyer (Richard Gere) vies with an embittered ex-lover (Laura Linney) prosecuting an altar boy (Edward Norton) in a high-profile murder case.

programme.title: S.O.G.: The Book of Ward
programme.desc: Andre Ward, facing an all-too familiar series of obstacles, defies the odds and silences his critics with an undefeated boxing career, but walks away after choosing his role as a father and a husband over boxing.

programme.title: Just Another Immigrant: Romesh at the Greek
programme.desc: Romesh Ranganathan, a successful comedian in England, moves his entire family to Los Angeles to make it as a comedian in America; he then takes the drastic step of performing his first ever U.S. stand-up show at the historic Greek Theatre.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe.

programme.title: Marathon Man
programme.desc: The CIA and a Nazi death-camp dentist (Laurence Olivier) chase a New York graduate student (Dustin Hoffman).

programme.title: Vacation
programme.desc: Following in his father's footsteps, Rusty Griswold takes his wife and two sons on a cross-country road trip to America's favorite fun park, Walley World.

programme.title: For Greater Glory: The True Story of Cristiada
programme.desc: In the 1920s, the Mexican government's attempt to secularize the country sparks a rebellion known as the Cristero War.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.

programme.title: Out of the Furnace
programme.desc: A steelworker (Christian Bale) takes matters into his own hands when his brother (Casey Affleck) joins one of the Northeast's most-ruthless crime syndicates, then disappears.

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: A deep bond develops between a cantankerous trainer (Clint Eastwood) and the female boxer (Hilary Swank) he reluctantly takes under his wing.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. - Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba, Michael Cera, Kevin Costner, Jeremy Strong (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: After building an empire with bootleg alcohol, legendary crime boss Al Capone (Robert De Niro) rules Chicago with an iron fist. Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness (Kevin Costner) attempts to take Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force. Recruiting an elite group of lawmen who won't be swayed by bribes or fear, including Irish-American cop Jimmy Malone (Sean Connery), Ness renews his determination to bring Capone to justice. - Kevin Costner, Sean Connery, Robert De Niro, Andy Garcia, Charles Martin Smith (Crime drama)

programme.title: Dexter: Resurrection
programme.desc: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. - Michael C. Hall, Jack Alcott, James Remar, David Zayas, Peter Dinklage (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Dexter: Resurrection
programme.desc: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. - Michael C. Hall, Jack Alcott, James Remar, David Zayas, Peter Dinklage (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Marathon Man
programme.desc: Thomas "Babe" Levy (Dustin Hoffman) is a Columbia graduate student and long-distance runner who is oblivious to the fact that his older brother, Doc (Roy Scheider), is a government agent chasing down a Nazi war criminal (Laurence Olivier) -- that is, until Doc is murdered and Babe finds himself knee-deep in a tangle of stolen gems and sadistic madmen. Even his girlfriend, Elsa (Marthe Keller), becomes a suspect as everything Babe believed to be true is suddenly turned upside down. - Dustin Hoffman, Laurence Olivier, Roy Scheider, William Devane, Marthe Keller (Thriller, Action, Mystery, Drama, War)

programme.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
programme.desc: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed. - Kurt Russell, Stacy Keach, Steve Buscemi, Cliff Robertson, Peter Fonda (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Heist 88
programme.desc: A criminal mastermind decides to pull one last job before going to prison and recruits a group of young bank employees to steal millions in a daring and brazen assault on the U.S. banking system. - Courtney B. Vance, Keith David, Keesha Sharp, Rebecca Spence, Bentley Green (Crime drama)

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. - Chris Pine, Ben Foster, Gillian Jacobs, Eddie Marsan, JD Pardo (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: The Perfect Gamble
programme.desc: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino. - David Arquette, Danny A. Abeckaser, Daniella Pick Tarantino, Dean Miroshnikov, Herzl Tobey (Crime drama)

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: In the year 2019, America is a totalitarian state where the favorite television program is "The Running Man" -- a game show in which prisoners must run to freedom to avoid a brutal death. Having been made a scapegoat by the government, an imprisoned Ben Richards (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has the opportunity to make it back to the outside again by being a contestant on the deadly show, although the twisted host, Damon Killian (Richard Dawson), has no intention of letting him escape. - Arnold Schwarzenegger, Maria Conchita Alonso, Richard Dawson, Yaphet Kotto, Jim Brown (Action, Adventure, Science fiction)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: An art collector appeals to Jones to embark on a search for the Holy Grail. He learns that another archaeologist has disappeared while searching for the precious goblet, and the missing man is his own father, Dr. Henry Jones. The artifact is much harder to find than they expected, and its powers are too much for those impure in heart. - Harrison Ford, Sean Connery, Denholm Elliott, Alison Doody, John Rhys-Davies (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: It's the height of the Cold War, and famous archaeologist Indiana Jones (Harrison Ford), returning from his latest adventure, finds out his job at Marshall College is in jeopardy. He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world. - Harrison Ford, Cate Blanchett, Shia La Beouf, Karen Allen, Ray Winstone (Family, Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Ghost in the Shell
programme.desc: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human who is cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals. When terrorism reaches a new level that includes the ability to hack into people's minds and control them, Major is uniquely qualified to stop it. As she prepares to face a new enemy, Major discovers that her life was stolen instead of saved. Now, she will stop at nothing to recover her past while punishing those who did this to her. - Scarlett Johansson, Pilou Asbæk, "Beat" Takeshi Kitano, Michael Carmen Pitt, Juliette Binoche (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalsky, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space. - Sandra Bullock, George Clooney, Adam Cozens (Drama, Science fiction, Thriller)

If the spirits were anxious about the commotion a renovation and B&B will create in their home, it's nothing compared to when they realize Samantha is the first live person who can see and hear them. - Rose McIver, Utkarsh Ambudkar, Brandon Scott Jones, Richie Moriarty, Danielle Pinnock (Sitcom, Paranormal, Fantasy, Comedy, Thriller)

programme.title: Nation's Dumbest
programme.desc: "Nation's Dumbest" is a celebrity competition series with a twisted premise: it's the only game show where winning is the last thing anyone wants. Famous faces are sent back to "summer school" and must relive the highs and humiliations of school life through a mix of brain-teasing pop quizzes, fast-paced physical challenges, and tests built on long-buried classroom knowledge. Rather than striving for a top prize, contestants battle to stay out of last place, because the worst performer is publicly humiliated with the unwanted title of "The Nation's Dumbest." Each week, the "smartest" celebrity graduates and leaves the competition, narrowing the field until a high-stakes final exam determines who ultimately fails their way to the infamous crown. The show channels a spirit of playful self-mockery, celebrating humor, humility, and the universal experience of not always getting it right. (Game show)

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: This follow-up to the popular "Teen Titans" series takes a more comedic look at the superheroes, showing what life is like for the teens when their capes come off. Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich. But, of course, the heroes still fight crime in Jump City when the need arises. Whatever the situation, they're always ready for an adventure -- inside the house or out of it. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy)

programme.desc: No, this animated series is not about anthropomorphic chewing gum, it's about a young cat named Gumball Watterson. Gumball has a penchant for getting into trouble, often resulting from schemes he comes up with, but he never seems to learn his lesson. Gumball's best friend is a fish named Darwin, who used to be the family pet until he grew legs and became part of the family. Gumball resents his younger sister, Anais, because she is the smartest member of the family. Gumball's mother is the breadwinner in the family, working long hours at the rainbow factory, and his father stays at home watching TV and playing video games. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.desc: Brian Quaca is an excitable Texan, especially when it involves hunting and trapping wild boar, which cause billions of dollars of property damage annually in his home state. This series shows Quaca at work and play, whether it's guiding clients on high-energy hog hunts at home or using his marksman skill to bag white-tailed deer, turkeys or red stag around the world. Whether the weapon of choice is a bow, muzzleloader, rifle or shotgun, the chase is always one part skill, one part luck and a whole lot of fun for hosts Bill Jordan and David Blanton, as well as the special guests who join them on the hunts. In the mid-1980s, Jordan designed an exclusive camouflage pattern that became the foundation of the popular clothing brand Realtree, while Blanton is the executive producer of Realtree's popular Monster Bucks video series. programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)
